description: This PHP source file generates and manages a tree menu for requirement specifications within the TestLink open source test management platform. It initializes page settings, checks user permissions, builds a requirement tree menu, and renders the output using Smarty templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object with session-based arguments such as test project ID, name, base URL, and current user.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and returns a GUI configuration object used for rendering the page, including URLs and title.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the necessary rights to view or modify requirement specifications, by calling pageAccessCheck with appropriate rights.
